text:
marta: Heads up: onboarding sample app hit an error where templates blow up when catching exceptions from the async Python SDK.

josh: what error exactly?

marta: the template does `if e.request_id.startswith('req_')` inside the except block, but in the async client the exception arrives with `request_id` set to None and we get AttributeError.

andrea: could be two issues: parsing the request id from payload vs headers, and the exception object not being typed Optional[str].

samir: repro I saw — server returned 400 with body `{"error": {"message": "invalid prompt", "id": "req_qwerty"}}` and response header `x-request-id: req_qwerty`. The sync client sets e.request_id correctly but async path left headers as None because our aiohttp wrapper returns headers as CIMultiDictProxy which our parser didn't accept.

josh: nice catch. looks like _parse_error assumes headers is a dict-like with .get. our code does `headers.get('x-request-id')` without ensuring headers isn't None or a str.

andrea: also spotty typing — RedwoodAPIError currently has `request_id` without Optional so mypy doesn't warn about missing value.

marta: this caused a bad developer experience when new users ran the sample and saw an internal exception instead of the friendly error page. PRs incoming?

samir: plan: (1) defensive normalize_headers(headers) -> Optional[str], (2) update _parse_error to check payload keys `id`/`requestId`/`request_id`, (3) make RedwoodAPIError.request_id: Optional[str] = None, (4) add unit tests for header-only/payload-only/none, (5) add an integration test using the async context manager and aiohttp mock.

josh: add a migration note in changelog: customers who accessed e.request_id should handle None now. Also add a short DX note in onboarding sample to use `getattr(e, 'request_id') or 'unknown'` in templates.

ci-bot: created branch fix/async-exc-requestid and queued PR pipeline.

andrea: extra test: ensure retry logic preserves original_request_id when responses chain across retries.

marta: assigning myself to review the onboarding sample changes and will update infra bug tracker INFR-4987 with repro and fix.

josh: thanks — once CI passes let's merge and backport to the 0.11.x patch line.
